name: Note Block Assistant
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: 0x4e49434f4c45
description: Utility mod for making note block songs. (Formerly titled noteblock-assistant)

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Server command /nba: '/nba generate <measures> <beatsPerMeasure> <subdivisionsPerBeat> <subdivisionDelay> <instrumentBlock...>' builds a note-block song template (marker blocks, floor, repeaters) in front of the player in the direction they face; '/nba select <tracks>' reads a song from the world and '/nba placeCompact' rebuilds it compactly.
note: Not yet: /nba select and /nba placeCompact weren't tried (they need a song written into the template first).
